title: The pure-tensor cofan for a positive-length negative Koszul tensor is colimiting
statement: Let (C,J,O) be a small ringed site with commutative structure sheaf O [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let A be a commutative ring and rho:A -> Gamma(O) a ring homomorphism. For r,m natural numbers, a:Fin(r+1)->A, an arbitrary unbounded complex K, and an integer q, the cofan with point (ringedNegativeKoszulTensor O rho a m).obj K in degree q and legs ringedNegativeKoszulSummand O rho a m K q I, for all subsets I of Fin(r+1), is a coproduct of the objects K^(q+|I|). The tensor and its specified pure-tensor legs are those of [def-cbc-signed-koszul-completion-model] and [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. This asserts only the graded universal property, with no differential or coordinate matrix assertion.

lean.statement:
theorem isColimit_ringedNegativeKoszulSummands_succ
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) {A : Type z} [CommRing A]
    (ρ : A →+* RingCat.sectionsSubring (O.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin (r + 1) → A) (m : ℕ) (K : ringedSiteComplex O) (q : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk
      (((ringedNegativeKoszulTensor O ρ a m).obj K).X q)
      (ringedNegativeKoszulSummand O ρ a m K q)))
